subject: Billing arrangements after acquisition: LogiMetrics -> AcquirerPlex
messages:
From: Sarah Hudson <sarah.hudson@acquirerplex.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Eaton <mark.eaton@acquirerplex.com>, finance@acquirerplex.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing setup for LogiMetrics acquisition (billing entity change)

Hi Rohan,

Quick note following our close yesterday: AcquirerPlex, Inc. has completed the acquisition of LogiMetrics (effective 2026-07-01). We need to update billing for the Redwood account that was under LogiMetrics to the acquiring entity. Can you confirm the steps to:

- Update billing/legal entity to: AcquirerPlex, Inc.
  AcquirerPlex, Inc.
  410 Kingsway Ave
  London, WC2N 5DU
  UK
- Add VAT ID: GB123456789
- Re-issue any outstanding invoices under the new entity (we have an outstanding invoice INV-4521 for $23,400) and provide wire instructions so we can pay quickly.

Is there anything from our side you need (EIN/W-9, signed acquisition agreement)? Mark from procurement is copied. Attaching the signed asset purchase agreement for your records.

We also have a separate question about VAT handling for Redwood services delivered to our EU customers — do you apply reverse-charge or do we need to provide additional docs?

Thanks,
Sarah Hudson
CFO, AcquirerPlex
[signed-asset-purchase-agreement.pdf]
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Hudson <sarah.hudson@acquirerplex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Mark Eaton <mark.eaton@acquirerplex.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing setup for LogiMetrics acquisition (billing entity change)

Hi Sarah — congrats on closing, and thanks for the heads up. We can definitely move the account to AcquirerPlex and reissue the outstanding invoice. To make this smooth, could you please send the following:

1) W-9 (or equivalent tax document) for AcquirerPlex for our vendor file (if US entity).
2) Official VAT registration document for the GB VAT ID you listed.
3) Confirm the new primary billing contact email (to send future invoices) and a PO number if procurement wants one on the invoice.
4) Confirmation whether you want the outstanding INV-4521 re-issued under AcquirerPlex or if you prefer a credit + new invoice.

I'll loop in Marissa (our finance lead) to handle the reissuance and payment routing. We typically require the vendor update + tax docs before reissuing so our accounting system records the correct legal entity. Once we have those, Marissa will reissue the invoice and include our bank wiring instructions if you prefer to pay via wire.

Also, regarding VAT: if AcquirerPlex is VAT-registered in the UK and the place of supply is outside the UK or qualifies for reverse charge, we can mark the invoice accordingly — Marissa can confirm.

Next steps: please attach the W-9/VAT cert and confirm billing email. I'll track this internally and aim to have the invoice reissued within 3 business days of receiving documents.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Hudson <sarah.hudson@acquirerplex.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, mark.eaton@acquirerplex.com
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing setup for LogiMetrics acquisition (billing entity change)

Hi Sarah (and team),

Thanks — copied our required steps below to update our billing ledger and reissue INV-4521 under AcquirerPlex, Inc.:

Required from AcquirerPlex
- Completed vendor-update-form (attached) [Attachment: vendor-update-form.pdf]
- W-9 or W-8BEN-E (if foreign entity) OR VAT registration certificate for GB123456789
- Remittance email and PO number (optional but preferred)

Internal process & timeline
- Once we receive the completed form + tax docs, we will:
  * Create a new vendor record for AcquirerPlex in our accounting system.
  * Re-issue INV-4521 under AcquirerPlex (expected within 1 business day after vendor creation).
  * Set payment terms: reissued invoice will be Net 30 from issue date unless you request immediate wiring.

Payment options
- Wire (preferred for amounts > $10k): use the wiring instructions in the attached [bank-wiring-instructions.pdf]. Please include the invoice number on the wire reference.
- Card or ACH via our billing portal (we can send a secure invoice link if preferred).

VAT notes
- For EU/UK VAT: if AcquirerPlex is VAT-registered and the supply qualifies for reverse charge, provide the VAT cert and we will mark the invoice accordingly (zero-rated/reverse charge annotation). If the billing entity is outside the UK/EU, VAT may be applied per local rules.

Attachments: vendor-update-form.pdf, bank-wiring-instructions.pdf

If you'd like us to split the period (prorate) between LogiMetrics and AcquirerPlex for any overlapping subscription dates, note that in the vendor form and we can propose a prorated credit.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bank-wiring-instructions.pdf]
From: Sarah Hudson <sarah.hudson@acquirerplex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Eaton <mark.eaton@acquirerplex.com>, finance@acquirerplex.com
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 10:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Billing setup for LogiMetrics acquisition (billing entity change)

Thanks Marissa — attaching the docs now.

Attached: W-9_AcquirerPlex.pdf, signed-asset-purchase-agreement.pdf

Billing details for reissue:
- Legal name: AcquirerPlex, Inc.
- Billing contact: finance@acquirerplex.com
- Remittance address: 410 Kingsway Ave, London, WC2N 5DU, UK
- VAT ID: GB123456789
- PO (optional): PO-AP-9082 (procurement will include this on future orders)

We will arrange a wire for the reissued invoice immediately after you send it; target to complete the wire within 7 business days. Also, we noted one overlapping invoice period during the transfer — please advise if Redwood can issue a credit for the overlap and we can accept a single consolidated invoice under AcquirerPlex.

Thanks,
Sarah Hudson
CFO, AcquirerPlex
[Attachments: W-9_AcquirerPlex.pdf, signed-asset-purchase-agreement.pdf]

Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing setup for LogiMetrics acquisition (billing entity change)

Hi Sarah — appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments.

We received the W-9 and signed agreement. Marissa has created the vendor record and will reissue INV-4521 under AcquirerPlex, Inc. We will:

- Re-issue INV-4521 (new invoice INV-4521-RWI) with billing address and VAT ID you provided.
- Annotate VAT handling: reverse-charge where applicable for UK VAT-registered transactions.
- Include PO: PO-AP-9082 on the invoice per your request.
- Expect to publish the reissued invoice tomorrow (2026-07-09). Payment terms: Net 30 from reissue; wire details included on the invoice.

Regarding the overlap/proration: please add a short note in the vendor-update-form indicating which service dates you want credited and we will process a prorated credit on a follow-up credit memo. If you prefer, we can issue a single consolidated invoice that nets out the credit — we'll coordinate once Marissa has the proration details.

I've marked the internal ticket as resolved pending payment confirmation. If you want someone from our billing team to hop on a 15m call to walk through the wire process or the credit flow, happy to set that up.

Thanks again and congrats on the close.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
